blinding_guess.why: All nine packet elements are declared with the expected names in both the ur5_robot and ur10_robot xacro macros and in the checked-in generated URDFs, so no name-level defect is visible. The only oddity touching listed elements is that the UR5 macro (even the non-joint-limited one) restricts wrist_1_joint to [-pi, 0.25*pi] and wrist_2/wrist_3 to [-pi, pi] while the UR10 macro uses [-2pi, 2pi]; whether that is a defect cannot be told from this snapshot alone.

notes: ur_description is a pure robot-model package (URDF/xacro + meshes + launch files that set param robot_description via xacro.py); it has no nodes, topics, services, actions or message definitions, so msg_type, definition_id and all QoS/rate fields are null (ROS 1, no QoS). The packet elements are URDF links (frames) and joints. No declares template fits a URDF resource, so each is recorded in the api form with the symbol exactly as written in the xacro macros (${prefix}<name>) and the macro declaration line, whitespace collapsed; the shipped wrappers ur5_robot.urdf.xacro, ur5_joint_limited_robot.urdf.xacro, ur10_robot.urdf.xacro and ur10_joint_limited_robot.urdf.xacro instantiate the macros with prefix="", and the checked-in generated URDFs (ur5_robot.urdf, ur10_robot.urdf and the joint-limited ones) hard-code the bare names base_link, ee_link, ee_fixed_joint, shoulder_pan_joint, shoulder_lift_joint, elbow_joint, wrist_1_joint, wrist_2_joint, wrist_3_joint. Frame for the two link elements is the link name as written in the macro; frame for the joint elements is left null because the schema does not say which frame a joint maps to (URDF: origin in parent link, axis in joint/child frame). Joint parent->child: shoulder_pan_joint base_link->shoulder_link; shoulder_lift_joint shoulder_link->upper_arm_link; elbow_joint upper_arm_link->forearm_link; wrist_1_joint forearm_link->wrist_1_link; wrist_2_joint wrist_1_link->wrist_2_link; wrist_3_joint wrist_2_link->wrist_3_link; ee_fixed_joint (type fixed) wrist_3_link->ee_link with origin xyz 0 ${wrist_3_length} 0, rpy 0 0 ${pi/2.0}. Units: revolute joints recorded as rad because limits/velocities are written as multiples of pi; the fixed joint and the frames have no units recorded. Transmissions (ur5/ur10.transmission.xacro) map each of the six revolute joints to an actuator with hardwareInterface EffortJointInterface for gazebo_ros_control; this declares the command interface the robot exposes rather than an exclusive claim, so exclusive is empty. Other observations not in the packet: ur5.gazebo.xacro references a non-existent link 'universal_robot'; ur10.gazebo.xacro references ${prefix}shoulder_pan_link, ${prefix}shoulder_lift_link and ${prefix}elbow_link, which the ur10 macro does not declare (its links are shoulder_link, upper_arm_link, forearm_link). The ur10 macro takes params 'prefix joint_limited', the ur5 macro only 'prefix' (joint-limited UR5 is a separate file). launch/test.launch references joint_state_publisher (param use_gui), robot_state_publisher state_publisher and rviz with $(find urdf_tutorial)/urdf.rviz; these launch-level references are not listed in references.
